shortDescription: Radiant World and Sapphire Minmetals have filed a lawsuit against Glencore LSE:GLEN in Singapore claiming $2 billion in damages, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing a senior executive at the group of companies.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
